//: Deliberate relaxations vs base.json (app glue code only — packages keep full strictness):
target ES2017 — create-next-app default; Next.js transpiles bundles itself, so a lower target only widens browser support, never weakens type-checking.

noUncheckedIndexedAccess off — app code does frequent positional/dict access (params, searchParams, segmented arrays); enabling it would force pervasive ?? guards across every route/component with no real safety gain at the app layer.

noUnusedLocals/noUnusedParameters off — Next.js route/lifecycle signatures (generateMetadata, layout params, unused request args) legitimately carry unused vars; Biome noUnusedVariables already reports real dead code at lint level.
